goal: Disconnect HTTP clients that take too long to send a complete request
Prevent unauthenticated callers from trickling bytes to exhaust connection slots and block legitimate RPCs
agreement: Support for mitigating slow-loris attacks and repetitive automated reports (pinheadmz)
Detailed review and acceptance of test coverage and server cleanup behavior (hodlinator)
All prior review suggestions and test assertion concerns have been addressed

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fixes an RPC denial of service where slow clients exhaust connection slots
Unauthenticated connections trickling bytes can bypass idle timeouts and block all legitimate RPC traffic
